description.value:
Gemini — 2nd Technique, gained at level 6.

Saga governed the Sanctuary as two people at once.

You project your consciousness into an astral body anywhere within 200 feet that you can see or have visited. For up to 10 minutes you perceive and speak through it.

The astral body is invisible to creatures without a sixth sense or see invisibility, cannot be damaged or physically interacted with, and cannot attack — but you may cast mental Techniques through it, using its position as the origin.

Your own body is unconscious and off-guard for the duration. Damage to it ends the effect and leaves you stunned 1.

Heightening (+2 levels) The range increases by 200 feet and the duration by 5 minutes.

On a day your constellation is Ascendant this Technique heightens as though you were 4 levels higher; on a Zenith, 8 levels higher.
